## Given Information
- Paper: **100 sheets per inch** (each sheet = 0.01 inches thick)
- Each sheet printed on **both sides** → 2 pages per sheet
- Book thickness: **1.5 inches**

## Calculation

**Step 1:** Number of sheets
$$1.5 \text{ inches} \times 100 \text{ sheets/inch} = 150 \text{ sheets}$$

**Step 2:** Number of pages (2 pages per sheet)
$$150 \times 2 = 300 \text{ pages}$$

## Final Answer

**The book contains 300 pages.**
